name: wavert-language
description: Syntax highlighting, brackets, snippets, documentation on hover and in completions, call completions, parameter hints, and checking with wvc as you edit for Wavert (.wvt)

wavert.libPath.description: The standard library folder that '$lib/' imports come from, for hovers and completions. Empty: found from wavert.wvcPath, or the Wavert repository the file is in.

wavert.wvcPath.description: The wvc compiler, which checks files as they are edited (wavert.check). Its standard library is found as wvc finds it: lib/ next to wvc, then one folder up. Empty: a wvc built in the Wavert repository the file is in, in .wvt/ or wvc/.

wavert.check.description: Check Wavert files with wvc as they are edited: show its errors, and use the types it infers in hovers and to complete a record's fields. Needs wvc: the wavert.wvcPath setting, or a wvc built in the Wavert repository the file is in.
